level.title: B2 Upper-Intermediate Punjabi
goals: Report viewpoints and reason about unreal alternatives accurately.
Use passive and formal Punjabi in public or professional contexts.
Build balanced arguments and choose register with cultural awareness.

lessons.title: Reported Speech and Viewpoints
lessons.learn: Report what another person said, asked, or believed without losing the original viewpoint. Punjabi commonly uses ਕਿ (ki) to introduce reported content and adjusts pronouns or time expressions to the reporting context.

grammar.title: Reporting with ਕਿ
grammar.explain: Place a reporting clause before ਕਿ (ki), then give the reported message. Punjabi often keeps a natural tense rather than mechanically shifting every verb as English sometimes does.
grammar.pattern: reporter + reporting verb + ਕਿ + reported clause

examples.t: ਉਸ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਕੱਲ੍ਹ ਆਵੇਗੀ।
examples.r: us ne keha ki uh kallh avegi.
examples.en: She said that she would come the next day.

examples.t: ਅਧਿਆਪਕ ਨੇ ਪੁੱਛਿਆ ਕਿ ਕੰਮ ਕਿਸ ਨੇ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੀ।
examples.r: adhiapak ne puchhia ki kam kis ne kita si.
examples.en: The teacher asked who had done the work.

examples.t: ਖ਼ਬਰਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
examples.r: khabran anusar minh pai sakda hai.
examples.en: According to the news, it may rain.

mistakes: Do not treat ਕਿ (ki, “that”) as ਕੀ (ki, “what”); their spelling and grammatical roles differ.

dialogue.en: She said that she would arrive late.

dialogue.t: ਕੀ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਦੱਸਿਆ?
dialogue.r: ki us ne karan dassia?
dialogue.en: Did she give a reason?

dialogue.r: han, us ne keha ki rel ruk gai si.
dialogue.en: Yes, she said that the train had stopped.

lessons.title: Hypotheses and Unreal Conditions
lessons.learn: Discuss imagined present and past outcomes. These patterns let advanced learners consider alternatives, regrets, and consequences using ਜੇ (je), ਤਾਂ (tan), and conditional verb forms.

grammar.title: Unreal ਜੇ…ਤਾਂ conditions
grammar.explain: Use ਜੇ plus a past habitual or pluperfect form for an unreal condition; the result often uses a conditional ending such as -ਦਾ/-ਦੀ. Context shows whether the speaker imagines the present or regrets the past.
grammar.pattern: ਜੇ + unreal condition, ਤਾਂ + conditional result

examples.t: ਜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋਲ ਸਮਾਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਆਉਂਦਾ।
examples.r: je mere kol sama hunda, tan main aunda.
examples.en: If I had time, I would come.

examples.t: ਜੇ ਅਸੀਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਨਿਕਲੇ ਹੁੰਦੇ, ਤਾਂ ਰੇਲ ਮਿਲ ਜਾਂਦੀ।
examples.r: je asin pahilan nikle hunde, tan rel mil jandi.
examples.en: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

examples.t: ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਦੱਸਦਾ, ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦੀ।
examples.r: je tun dassda, tan main madad kardi.
examples.en: If you had told me, I would have helped.

mistakes: Do not use a simple future in both clauses when describing an unreal past result.

dialogue.en: I wish we had planned earlier.

lessons.title: Passive and Impersonal Style
lessons.learn: Recognise and produce passive constructions used in notices, news, and formal explanations. Punjabi forms many passives with a perfective participle plus ਜਾਣਾ (jana), while impersonal wording keeps attention on the action.

grammar.title: Passive with ਜਾਣਾ
grammar.explain: Make a passive from the perfective verb plus a form of ਜਾਣਾ (jana). The participle agrees with the grammatical subject, and the agent may be omitted when unknown or unimportant.

examples.t: ਨਵਾਂ ਨਿਯਮ ਲਾਗੂ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
examples.r: navan niyam lagu kita gia hai.
examples.en: A new rule has been implemented.

examples.t: ਸਾਰੇ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੂਚਿਤ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ।
examples.r: sare memberan nun suchit kita gia.

mistakes: Do not translate every English passive literally; use an active Punjabi sentence when the agent is central and natural.

dialogue.t: ਕੀ ਨਵਾਂ ਐਲਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਿਤ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ?

dialogue.en: Yes, it was published yesterday.

lessons.title: Formal Messages and Applications
lessons.learn: Write courteous messages, requests, and short applications. Organise purpose, supporting detail, and requested action while using formal Punjabi address and closing conventions.

grammar.title: Formal purpose and request clauses
grammar.explain: State the purpose with ਸੰਬੰਧੀ (sabandhi) or ਲਈ (lai). Use ਆਪ ਜੀ ਨੂੰ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ (ap ji nun benti hai ki) before the requested action, then close respectfully.
grammar.pattern: context + ਸੰਬੰਧੀ; ਆਪ ਜੀ ਨੂੰ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ + request

examples.t: ਆਪ ਜੀ ਨੂੰ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਵੇ।
examples.r: ap ji nun benti hai ki meri arzi manzur kiti jave.
examples.en: I respectfully request that my application be approved.

mistakes: Avoid casual ਤੂੰ/ਤੁਸੀਂ forms in a formal application when ਆਪ ਜੀ (ap ji) is expected.

lessons.title: Balanced Debate and Evidence
lessons.learn: Present a structured argument, acknowledge another view, and qualify a conclusion. This lesson moves beyond simple opinions to evidence, contrast, scope, and cautious claims.

grammar.title: Concession with ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ
grammar.explain: Use ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ (halanki) to concede a point before giving a contrasting main claim. Use ਇਸ ਲਈ (is lai) for a consequence, and ਕੁਝ ਹੱਦ ਤੱਕ (kujh hadd takk) to limit agreement.
grammar.pattern: ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ + conceded point, main claim; evidence + ਇਸ ਲਈ + conclusion

examples.t: ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਮਹਿੰਗੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਦੇ ਫ਼ਾਇਦੇ ਵੱਧ ਹਨ।
examples.r: halanki yojana mahngi hai, is de faide vadh han.
examples.en: Although the plan is expensive, its benefits are greater.

examples.t: ਸਬੂਤ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਹਨ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਮੈਂ ਇਸ ਪੱਖ ਨਾਲ ਸਹਿਮਤ ਹਾਂ।
examples.r: sabut sapashat han, is lai main is pakh nal sahimat han.
examples.en: The evidence is clear; therefore I agree with this position.

examples.t: ਮੈਂ ਕੁਝ ਹੱਦ ਤੱਕ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਾਲ ਸਹਿਮਤ ਹਾਂ।
examples.r: main kujh hadd takk tuhade nal sahimat han.
examples.en: I agree with you to some extent.

mistakes: Do not use ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ (halanki) and ਪਰ (par) repeatedly in the same short sentence unless contrast truly needs both.

dialogue.r: ki shahir vich hor bassan chahidiyan han?
dialogue.en: Does the city need more buses?

dialogue.r: han, kiunki bhir bare sabut sapashat han.
dialogue.en: Yes, because the evidence about crowding is clear.

dialogue.r: sahi, par lamme same vich faida hovega.
dialogue.en: True, but it will be beneficial in the long term.

lessons.title: Register, Idiom, and Nuance
lessons.learn: Choose language suited to a close friend, elder, workplace, or public audience. Interpret common figurative phrases through context instead of translating each word literally.

grammar.title: Choosing register and reading idiom
grammar.explain: Respectful pronouns and verb endings mark formal register. Idioms such as ਹੱਥ ਵਟਾਉਣਾ (hatth vatauna) carry a conventional meaning—“to lend a hand”—that must be learned as a whole.
grammar.pattern: audience + appropriate address; idiom + contextual meaning

examples.t: ਕੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੱਥ ਵਟਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ?
examples.r: ki tusin mera hatth vata sakde ho?
examples.en: Could you lend me a hand?

examples.t: ਉਸ ਨੇ ਗੱਲ ਨੂੰ ਦਿਲ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਾ ਲਿਆ।
examples.r: us ne gall nun dil utte la lia.
examples.en: He or she took the matter to heart.

examples.t: ਇਹ ਲਹਿਜਾ ਰਸਮੀ ਮੀਟਿੰਗ ਲਈ ਢੁਕਵਾਂ ਹੈ।
examples.r: ih lahija rasmi miting lai dhukvan hai.
examples.en: This tone is appropriate for a formal meeting.

mistakes: Do not infer an idiom’s meaning by translating its words separately; confirm its conventional contextual sense.

dialogue.t: ਇਹ ਸੁਨੇਹਾ ਮੈਨੇਜਰ ਲਈ ਢੁਕਵਾਂ ਹੈ?
dialogue.r: ih suneha manager lai dhukvan hai?
dialogue.en: Is this message appropriate for the manager?

dialogue.t: ਭਾਵ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਲਹਿਜਾ ਗ਼ੈਰ-ਰਸਮੀ ਹੈ।
dialogue.r: bhav sapashat hai, par lahija ghair-rasmi hai.
dialogue.en: The meaning is clear, but the tone is informal.

dialogue.en: How can I make it more formal?

dialogue.t: ਆਪ ਜੀ ਲਿਖੋ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਵਾਲਾ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤੋ।

dialogue.en: Write “aap ji” and use a request form.
